²1 To fall or come down, descend, alight, sink down; {#nipatantI patimapyapAtayat#}
 <ls>R. 8. 38</ls>; <ls>Bk. 15. 27</ls>.
.²2 To be cast at, be directed towards; {#nipeturantaHkaraRErnarendrAH#} <ls>R. 6. 11</ls>.
.²3 To throw oneself down (as at the feet), fall prostrate; {#devAstadante#}
 {#haramUQaBAryaM kirIwabadDAYjalayo nipatya#} <ls>Ku. 7. 92</ls>; <ls>R. 4. 50</ls>; <ls>Bh. 2. 31</ls>.
.²4 To fall or descend into, meet in; {#tvayyeva nipatantyoGA jAhnavIyA#}
 {#ivArRave#} <ls>R. 10. 26</ls>.
.²5 To fall upon, attack, rush at or upon; {#siMho SiSurapi nipatati madamalinakapolaBittizu#}
 {#gajezu#} <ls>Bh. 2. 38</ls>.
.²6 To happen, occur, take place, fall to oneʼs lot; {#sakfdaMSo nipatati#} <ls>Ms. 9. 47</ls>.
.²7 To be placed, occupy a place; {#aByarhitaM pUrvaM nipatati#}.
.²8 To flow in, discharge into.
.²9 To fall into ruin.
.²10 To fall into (any state).
.²11 To be miscarried (as the foetus).

.²1 To cause to fall down, throw or hurl down.
.²2 To kill, destroy; {#tAtaM nipAtya saha banDujanAkzitoyEH#} <ls>Mu. 5. 7</ls>; <ls>Pt. 3. 63</ls>.
.²3 To inlay, emboss.
.²4 To direct (the eyes) upon.
.²5 To spit out.
.²6 To raise or levy (as a tribute).
.²7 (In <ab>gram.</ab>) To put down as a special or irregular form, to mention as
 an irregular formation; {#ete paYcaviMSatirajantA nipAtyante#} <ls>Sk.</ls>
